name: 40361 · Paris, KY
findings: ZIP 40361 (Paris) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40361 (Paris) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 40361 (Paris) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
